title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten upcoming, publicly listed City of Boston activities with a stated FREE price. Check each event page before heading out for any changes.

cards.title: Paint at Roslindale Wetlands
cards.subtitle: Roslindale Wetlands · September 12, 2026
cards.notes: Register through the City listing, then bring a friend to make a watercolor at the wetlands during the two-hour outdoor workshop.
cards.short_summary: A free, instructor-led outdoor watercolor session.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks lists this September 12 workshop at Roslindale Wetlands with a price of FREE and says instructors provide tips and techniques.
cards.source_title: Watercolor Painting Workshop #1: Roslindale Wetlands | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Scheduled September 12, 2026, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; registration is linked on the City event page.

cards.entity_name: Watercolor Painting Workshop #3: Copley Square Park
cards.title: Paint at Copley Square Park
cards.subtitle: Copley Square Park · September 19, 2026
cards.notes: Use the registration link, meet at Copley Square Park, and try the instructor-led techniques with classmates or visiting friends.
cards.short_summary: A free painting workshop in Back Bay.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks lists the Copley Square Park workshop on September 19 with a price of FREE and says it supports artists of all skill levels.
cards.source_title: Watercolor Painting Workshop #3: Copley Square Park | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Scheduled September 19, 2026, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; registration is linked on the City event page.

cards.title: Paint at Chandler Pond
cards.subtitle: Chandler Pond · September 20, 2026
cards.notes: Register before going, then spend the workshop making a small painting beside Chandler Pond with guidance from the event instructor.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor art session by the pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks lists this Chandler Pond watercolor workshop on September 20 with a price of FREE and instructor-provided tips and techniques.
cards.source_title: Watercolor Painting Workshop #4: Chandler Pond | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Scheduled September 20, 2026, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; registration is linked on the City event page.

cards.title: Paint at Scarboro Pond
cards.subtitle: Scarboro Pond · September 26, 2026
cards.notes: Sign up through the event page and use the two-hour session to sketch and paint around Scarboro Pond with an instructor present.
cards.short_summary: A free guided watercolor workshop outdoors.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks lists the Scarboro Pond session on September 26 with a price of FREE and identifies it as a watercolor painting workshop.
cards.source_title: Watercolor Painting Workshop #5: Scarboro Pond | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Scheduled September 26, 2026, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; registration is linked on the City event page.

cards.entity_name: Watercolor Painting Workshop #6: Boston Public Garden
cards.title: Paint in the Public Garden
cards.subtitle: Boston Public Garden · September 27, 2026
cards.notes: Reserve a spot through the City listing and make an outdoor watercolor in the Public Garden during this instructor-led morning session.
cards.short_summary: A free art activity in the Public Garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks lists the Boston Public Garden workshop on September 27 with a price of FREE and says the series serves artists of all skill levels.
cards.source_title: Watercolor Painting Workshop #6: Boston Public Garden | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Scheduled September 27, 2026, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; registration is linked on the City event page.

cards.title: Walk the Franklin Park Ruins Tour
cards.subtitle: Franklin Park · August 8, 2026
cards.notes: Meet on Pierpont Road behind the zoo, wear comfortable shoes, and follow a Park Ranger through the park’s documented historic ruins.
cards.short_summary: A free Park Ranger walking tour of Franklin Park history.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Franklin Park Ruins Tour as FREE, for all ages, and describes a guided walk through the park’s forgotten ruins.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled August 8, 2026, 2:00–3:00 p.m.; meet at Pierpont Road behind Franklin Park Zoo and dress for walking.

cards.title: Build basic bike skills
cards.subtitle: Boston Bikes · 2026 season
cards.notes: Register for a Basic Skills workshop if you want a structured way to practice starting, stopping, turning, and hand signals with staff.
cards.short_summary: A free adult bike-skills class with equipment provided.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Bikes states its adult learn-to-bike workshops are free, require registration, and provide bikes and helmets; Basic Skills covers starting, stopping, turning, and hand signaling.
cards.access_notes: Registration is required; consult the 2026 schedule and workshop locations on the City page.

cards.title: Practice road readiness
cards.subtitle: Boston Bikes · 2026 season
cards.notes: Choose a Road Readiness session to practice hand signals, gear changes, and defensive riding in a supervised parking-lot class.
cards.short_summary: A free workshop for building street-riding confidence.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Bikes states its adult learn-to-bike workshops are free, require registration, and provide bikes and helmets; Road Readiness teaches hand signals, bike handling, gear changes, and defensive riding.
cards.access_notes: Registration is required; the City page provides the 2026 schedule and workshop locations.

cards.title: Join an on-street skills ride
cards.subtitle: Boston Bikes · 2026 season
cards.notes: Register for the Level 4 group ride to practice riding on paths, separated bike lanes, and low-stress streets with instruction.
cards.short_summary: A free group ride for advancing bike confidence.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Bikes states its adult learn-to-bike workshops are free and require registration; its On-Street Skills class is a 90-minute group ride on paths, bike lanes, and low-stress shared streets.
cards.access_notes: Registration is required; intended for riders comfortable on paths who want supervised on-street practice.

cards.title: See Hamilton outdoors
cards.subtitle: City Hall Plaza · September 4, 2026
cards.notes: Meet at City Hall Plaza for the scheduled outdoor screening; the City lists free popcorn while supplies last, so bring a layer for evening weather.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor screening of Hamilton (2020).
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks lists the September 4 City Hall Plaza screening of Hamilton (2020) with a price of FREE and states that free popcorn will be provided while supplies last.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled September 4, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. at 1 City Hall Square; listed as an outdoor event.
